notes.title: Chat with the Voice Actress
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40376419/75a5281aaa6d741d46fa376ce49f3f4ba0a70aba.gif[/img]

[h2]Play The Death Into Trouble Free demo![/h2]
[i]Steam Next Fest starts TODAY and we hope you have a lot of fun![/i]

Between October 1st - 7th, you'll be able to explore the Purgatory initial sectors and a small part of Heaven and Hell. This small portion of the experience should give you a taste of what's to come in the full game.

we've also pinned a [[url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/1613960/discussions/0/2957165853989368800/]discussion post[/url]] where you can leave your feedback about our demo.

Click "Set reminder" and don't miss our Live Streams :)

Day 1 - October 4
20:00 BRT / 16:00 PDT ([url=https://www.timeanddate.com/worldclock/fixedtime.html?msg=The+Death+Into+Trouble+live+stream&iso=20211004T20&p1=45&ah=1]click here[/url] to convert the time to your timezone)

14:00 BRT / 10:00 PDT ([url=https://www.timeanddate.com/worldclock/fixedtime.html?msg=The+Death+Into+Trouble+live+stream&iso=20211005T14&p1=45&ah=1]click here[/url] to convert the time to your timezone)

See you all in the stream!
